nodes.title: ⚡ Model Optimizer

en.text:
Loads the model, text encoder and VAE that suit your card. 💡 Run the Optimization Report first (Settings > LC Settings ⚙️ > Optimization).

**LC Model Optimizer ⚡**
- Loads the model, text encoder and VAE that suit your card, with the speed-ups that work on it. Downloads recommended files on the first run. Covers Krea 2 (Turbo and Raw), SDXL, Illustrious, Pony and more, plus Custom for any other model.

**LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡**
- The same as LC Model Optimizer, plus an LC_PIPE out (model 2 carries Ideogram 4's second model).

**LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡**
- The video version: model, text encoder, video and audio VAE and latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 and LTX 2.5 / 2.3.

**LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡**
- The same as LC Model Optimizer Video, plus an LC_PIPE out (vae 2 carries the audio VAE).

nodes.title: 🎚️ LoRAs

en.text:
Any number of LoRAs from one node.

**LC LoRA Loader 🎚️**
- Applies any number of LoRAs from one node, with enable, strength and drag-to-reorder per row.

**LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️**
- Builds the same LoRA list as LC LoRA Loader, output as a LORA_STACK.

**LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️**
- Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip.

nodes.title: 📝 Conditioning

en.text:
Prompts in, conditioning out.

**LC Positive**
- A positive prompt text box.

**LC Negative**
- A negative prompt text box.

**Prompt to Conditioning**
- Encodes a text prompt into CLIP conditioning.

**LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero**
- Encodes a prompt into conditioning and also outputs a zeroed copy for the negative.

**LC Reference Latent**
- Attaches up to eight reference latents to conditioning.

nodes.title: ⚙️ Sampler Configure

en.text:
One place for steps, step swap, denoise, CFG, sampler and scheduler.

**LC Sampler Configure**
- Central dual-pass sampler settings: steps, swap point, detailer steps, denoise, CFGs, sampler and scheduler.

**LC Sampler Configure Simple**
- Single-pass sampler settings with one CFG and no step swap.

**LC Sampler Configure (pipe)**
- Dual-pass sampler settings with an optional pipe in and a pipe out.

**LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)**
- Simple sampler settings that read from and write to an LC_PIPE.

**LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out**
- Unpacks an LC_PIPE into the sampler configure sockets, plus the latent.

**LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️**
- Pick the sampler and scheduler once and wire them to every KSampler, so they all change together.

nodes.title: 📉 Sigmas

en.text:
Build, draw, resample and split the sigma schedule.

**LC Sigmas (BETA)**
- One scheduler for one- and two-pass sampling: sigma curve presets (base, beta, flowmatch, hyperbolic, gaussian, your saved curves) you can bend by dragging the graph, step swap, denoise, continue or renoise on the second pass, and sigma shift. Takes regular and RES4LYF / ClownShark sampler names.

**LC Sigma Curve**
- Draw a custom sigma curve on the node, save it, and reuse it.

**LC Sigma Resample**
- Resamples a sigma curve to a new step count while keeping its start and end sigma (also registered as LCChangeStepCount).

**LC Basic Scheduler**
- Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling.

**LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)**
- Splits sigma curves at a swap step into a high and a low set.

**LC Split Sigma Scheduler**
- Splits sigmas between two models for a dual-model SamplerCustomAdvanced.

**LC Denoise 💉**
- Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler.

nodes.title: 🚀 Speed & Detail

en.text:
Faster sampling and finer detail, plugged into the samplers.

**LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀**
- About 2x faster sampling (about 1.4x on SDXL / Pony / Illustrious), same quality: the picture starts at half size and grows to full size partway through. Plug it into the high pass sampler.

**LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)**
- A KSampler with Speed Boost built in. Same inputs, plus start / end at step so it can chain into another sampler. Takes ClownShark (RES4LYF) samplers.

**LC Detail Daemon (BETA)**
- Adds fine detail by hiding a little of the noise from the model over a window of the steps, on the original Detail Daemon schedule. Look only (default), classic and keep structure modes. Sampler version. Goes on the low pass sampler.

**LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)**
- The same Detail Daemon as a model patch, for a plain KSampler.

nodes.title: About this workflow 👋

en.text:
# LC123 Examples - Models, Sampling & Sigmas

Load the right model for your card, set up the samplers once, and shape the sigmas.

- These are examples of every node in each section, with a short note on what it does. They are not wired: drop the ones you need into your own workflow.
- 💡 Hover any input for its tooltip. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes).

**In this workflow:**
- ⚡ Model Optimizer
- 🎚️ LoRAs
- 📝 Conditioning
- ⚙️ Sampler Configure
- 📉 Sigmas
- 🚀 Speed & Detail
